elite._why_xp_bonus: F07#4 ledger margin (ralph/reports/CLOUDREACH-LANE/f07-route-ledger/summary.md). Was 0: at 50% wild engagement the lead met Captain Veyra's band and the L33 exit with zero slack and 77% of its XP came from optional wilds. PROGRESSION §7: tune existing awards so the ordinary route supports its intended encounters. Scale: about 0.8 of a level per member at L29-30 (XP to next 1922-1998), no multi-level spike; larger than the Warden precedent (400 XP, about 0.3 of a level at L20, band5_stronghold_approach/trainers.json), because Voss is the long Voss-to-Veyra leg's only required payout. TUNABLE.

Coordinator ruling (a): restore it as activity on the shortened legs, not candy, bonus or lower margins. High Roost table, gated by fly_traversal_unlocked, so the pair is absent on the inbound Maela walk and appears only on the post-flight return, like the other floor-loop return pairs; the outbound ravine pairs here are one-time fights by then. Placed on the authored polyline core at its interpolated height, between the existing pairs and pickups (about 18 m or more from each); no pickup, flag or route change.
